exposure: Irregularity of the posterior bladder wall
Loss of the retroplacental clear zone
Placental bulge or focal exophytic mass
outcome: Prevalence of sonographic markers for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
cohort: 174 pregnant women at low-risk for PAS presenting for routine second-trimester ultrasound
finding: Several sonographic markers for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) are common in low-risk pregnancies, questioning their independent predictive value in the absence of risk factors.
